soundExperience.text: Voice, silence, rhythm and space become the material of a cultural experience.

about.label: 03 / About Soundia
headline: We create
more than sound.
We create
experience.
about.body: Soundia is a creative audio studio in Riga. We work with museums, cultural institutions, city routes and educational projects, turning script, voice and sound into a complete experience.

steps.title: Listen
steps.text: We study the space, audience, dramaturgy and project task.

steps.title: Create
steps.text: We write, record voices, compose rhythm and build the sound world.

steps.title: Test
steps.text: We test route, pacing, clarity and emotional accuracy.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.text: We prepare launch materials and support publication.

courses.text: The homepage carries a short teaser. The full course list stays on the existing page.

items.question: Which languages do you work in?
items.answer: Soundia works in Russian, Latvian and English.

items.question: Can we order only recording or editing?
items.answer: Yes, the format is shaped around the project task.

items.question: How do we start?
items.answer: Send a short note about the idea, space and timeline — we will propose the next step.
